description: Return the full text of an indexed book by Gutenberg id, paginated by passage. Use from_seq + max_passages to page through it. For books in the catalog that are NOT indexed locally, returns the public gutenberg.org plain-text URL so the agent can fetch it directly.

from_seq.description: Passage index to start from (0-based, default 0).

max_passages.description: Maximum passages to return per call (default 40, max 200).

name: book_get_text
